entries.title: Romans 3:1
segments: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what is the profit of circumcision?

entries.title: Romans 3:2
segments: Much every way: first of all, that they were intrusted with the oracles of God.

entries.title: Romans 3:3
segments: For what if some were without faith? shall their want of faith make of none effect the faithfulness of God?

entries.title: Romans 3:4
segments: God forbid: yea, let God be found true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy words, And mightest prevail when thou comest into judgment.

entries.title: Romans 3:5
segments: But if our righteousness commendeth the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who visiteth with wrath? (I speak after the manner of men.)

entries.title: Romans 3:6
segments: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?

entries.title: Romans 3:7
segments: But if the truth of God through my lie abounded unto his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?

entries.title: Romans 3:8
segments: and why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), Let us do evil, that good may come? whose condemnation is just.

entries.title: Romans 3:9
segments: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we before laid to the charge both of Jews and Greeks, that they are all under sin;

entries.title: Romans 3:10
segments: as it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one;

entries.title: Romans 3:11
segments: There is none that understandeth, There is none that seeketh after God;

entries.title: Romans 3:12
segments: They have all turned aside, they are together become unprofitable; There is none that doeth good, no, not, so much as one:

entries.title: Romans 3:13
segments: Their throat is an open sepulchre; With their tongues they have used deceit: The poison of asps is under their lips:

entries.title: Romans 3:14
segments: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:

entries.title: Romans 3:15
segments: Their feet are swift to shed blood;

entries.title: Romans 3:16
segments: Destruction and misery are in their ways;

entries.title: Romans 3:17
segments: And the way of peace have they not known:

entries.title: Romans 3:18
segments: There is no fear of God before their eyes.

entries.title: Romans 3:19
segments: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it speaketh to them that are under the law; that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God:

entries.title: Romans 3:20
segments: because by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified in his sight; for through the law [cometh] the knowledge of sin.

entries.title: Romans 3:21
segments: But now apart from the law a righteousness of God hath been manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;

entries.title: Romans 3:22
segments: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ unto all them that believe; for there is no distinction;

entries.title: Romans 3:23
segments: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;

entries.title: Romans 3:24
segments: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:

entries.title: Romans 3:25
segments: whom God set forth [to be] a propitiation, through faith, in his blood, to show his righteousness because of the passing over of the sins done aforetime, in the forbearance of God;

entries.title: Romans 3:26
segments: for the showing, [I say], of his righteousness at this present season: that he might himself be just, and the justifier of him that hath faith in Jesus.

entries.title: Romans 3:27
segments: Where then is the glorying? It is excluded. By what manner of law? of works? Nay: but by a law of faith.

entries.title: Romans 3:28
segments: We reckon therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.

entries.title: Romans 3:29
segments: Or is God [the God] of Jews only? is he not [the God] of Gentiles also? Yea, of Gentiles also:

entries.title: Romans 3:30
segments: if so be that God is one, and he shall justify the circumcision by faith, and the uncircumcision through faith.

entries.title: Romans 3:31
segments: Do we then make the law of none effect through faith? God forbid: nay, we establish the law.
